title: Otto Skorzeny's ratline used Knights of Malta passports

tellings.quote: Yeah. Auto Scorzani, who ran the rat line, you know, of of smuggling them all out of there. And they were knights of Malta passports.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about Otto Skorzeny, a Nazi commando officer who he says ran a "ratline", a secret escape route smuggling Nazis out of Europe after World War Two. Sheehan says the people escaping used passports from the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order. If true, it would mean a respected religious body helped Nazis get away.
